name: field-08
description: Checkbox choice cards for optional add-ons with a running monthly total.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Checkbox } from "@workspace/ui/components/checkbox" import { Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSet, FieldTitle, } from "@workspace/ui/components/field" const addons = [ { id: "backups", title: "Daily backups", hint: "30-day retention", price: 8 }, { id: "sso", title: "Single sign-on", hint: "SAML and SCIM", price: 25 }, { id: "support", title: "Priority support", hint: "4-hour response time", price: 40, }, ] export default function AddOnCheckboxCards() { const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState(["backups"]) const total = addons .filter((a) => selected.includes(a.id)) .reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.price, 0) return (
Add-ons Extend your workspace. Cancel any time. {addons.map((a) => ( setSelected((prev) => checked ? [...prev, a.id] : prev.filter((x) => x !== a.id) ) } /> {a.title} {a.hint} +{"$"} {a.price} ))}

Add-ons total:{" "} {"$"} {total}/mo

) }
